title: Acceptance of AI-Assisted Preoperative Evaluation Among Patients - An Anonymous Survey Study
summary: The aim of this study is to identify factors that influence patients’ willingness to incorporate AI solutions into their preoperative care. The identified factors can serve as the basis for further research and the development of patient-centered evaluation systems.
conditions: All medical conditions that require a procedure under anesthesia

interventions.name: Immersive scenario for preoperative evaluation: Manually compiling and transferring findings. No support in developing the best possible perioperative care.
Immersive scenario for preoperative evaluation: Automatic preliminary evaluation and compilation of findings and recommendations using a rule-based algorithm. Review and approval by a physician.
Immersive scenario for preoperative evaluation: automatic preliminary analysis and compilation of findings and recommendations by AI. Review and approval by a physician.
Immersive Scenario for Preoperative Evaluation: Fully automated analysis of medical records using AI. No routine review by a physician

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Sufficient knowledge of German
- ASA I–IV
- Pre-operative evaluation for elective surgery at the facility
Exclusion criteria:
- Referral for emergency surgery
- No informed consent
